knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A mobile quote covers travel, set-up and clean-down, materials, disposables and compliance costs, not the service time alone.
The steps for a stronger bleach must be reviewed first. The price is then set from the cost of those steps.
WorkSafe Victoria confirms that WorkCover registration is generally required when the business employs any workers.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks that a sample quote shows the visit, travel, add-ons and materials as separate lines
Assessor checks that every add-on on the sample quote appears on the approved service list
Assessor observes the candidate explain the public liability position for Victoria and name the check to make
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample quote with the lines shown
Approved pricing sheet with its review date
Written answer identifying the insurance point to be checked and the check to make
stopWorkCriteria: A chemical add-on is quoted before the service has been reviewed
A quote is issued for a service not on the approved list
